text.p: Prospects for PDCP Development Bank this year are brighter with its plan to formalise its merger with Asian Bank in the next three months, a senior official of PDCP said on Tuesday.
PDCP said its unaudited net income reached 118.4 million pesos in 1996 against the 1995 audited figure of 121.7 million pesos.
"The merger is expected to increase our networth to close to seven billion pesos from the present 2.1 billion. This will enable us to compete head-on with other banks," the official said.
Under the plan, PDCP will emerge as the surviving entity because it is a publicly listed company but it will eventually change its name, the official said.

PDCP and Asian Bank plan to ask the approval of the Central Bank for the transfer of Asian Bank's universal banking license to the merged bank. An application for a thrift bank will also be filed, the two banks said in a previous statement.
